### Day 56: 2 Samuel 11:6–17
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-56-2-samuel-11-617.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 11:14-15
Points:
- David's initial scheme to conceal his adultery was thwarted by Uriah's unwavering integrity.
- Instead of confessing when confronted by Uriah's honor, David chose to compound his sin with deeper evil.
- David exploited Joab's violent tendencies to orchestrate Uriah's demise in battle.
- Uriah faithfully and unknowingly delivered his own death warrant to his commander.
- Sin hardens the heart into cold betrayal, but God's righteousness will not allow such wickedness to go unpunished.
